reviews.text: Im a certified installer for sliding glass and bifolding doors here in Texas my company is called "Patio Door Pro" and Panoramic doors are my favorite door on the market for large sliding glass doors, they can accommodate what I need quickly and offer the larger sized panels that my customers desire. Ive never had an issue with the installation process though(its important to know what your doing on these particular style doors to prevent issues). Also love that they are built right here in Texas. If you want American quality and a unique door go with Panoramic! I highly recommend working with Chris Shaia or John Russell from the sales team when ordering doors, they have both been great to work with on these projects!
reviews.author: William Gerky

reviews.text:
I recently had an excellent experience with the warranty team at Panoramic Doors. We’ve had our 16’ vinyl doors since 2022, but the main entrance recently began dragging and falling out of alignment.
Even though I didn't have the original invoice from my builder, my Case Manager, Amrie Jackson, worked with me to verify my purchase using my original builder’s quote. The company flew a technician, Alex, all the way from California to Alabama to perform the service.
Alex was fantastic—he realigned the entire system and showed me how to perform basic maintenance. The doors now move more smoothly than the day we moved in!
It’s rare to find a company that stands by their product like this. Highly recommended for their professionalism and stellar communication.
reviews.author: Rob Montgomery

reviews.text: We love Panoramic Doors and their windows too!   We are so pleased to have one as a display in our showroom and it looks and operates like a dream.  We have already started installing them on Hilton Head Island and can’t wait to do more.   Great product!
reviews.author: Richard Barron

reviews.text: Panoramic Doors has killer product quality and amazing customer service. They tackled my one issue fast, sending two technicians, Ricky Rivera and Alex Rubio , to nail the fix. Their hands-on work and deep product knowledge blew me away. Huge thanks also to Amrie Jackson, who streamlined everything from my first call, going above and beyond to ensure I was thrilled-it left me seriously impressed.
reviews.author: George G

reviews.text: We love the versatility of our panoramic door. Our experience with the team was outstanding. I highly recommend to anyone building or remodeling. It is light weight and easy to use unlike other doors we tried.
reviews.author: Dianna Lee

reviews.text: I love the doors and my sales guy John was great .  The only reason I didn't give 5 stars was the contractor for the install process was not very good. A lot of mistakes were made and I had to keep calling them back.  The contractor didn't show up one time during the job. Only afterwards when we complained. Once we told our sales guy John, he was amazing and made sure that the contractor got all of the work completed.
reviews.author: Kelly Nelson

reviews.text:
Panoramic doors are the absolute best. If you’re looking for the ability to bring the outdoors into your living space, you can’t go wrong with a panoramic door.
As a professional remodel company, panoramic doors gives me the ability to offer my customers a quality, high end door, to enhance the Lake views from their patios and decks.
If you get the chance to work with Kolton, you’ll love the knowledge and professionalism. From my first call Kolton, walked me through answering any questions to design. I have purchased multiple panoramic doors from Kolton now and the experience is amazing.
reviews.author: David Carter

reviews.text: We could not be happier with our Panoramic Doors! We purchased them in 2021 and are local to their showroom. Ours are 10 feet high X 12 feet wide. We opted against the retractable screen because we were afraid our dogs would ruin it. Installation is a separate fee and I recommend going with one of their preferred installers because they are trained in how to install this door system. Our doors face southeast and do not get a lot of direct sun. They are also protected from rain by a large patio cover. That said, we love our doors and the unique stacking system - guests are super impressed when they see it. See my before and after pics.
reviews.author: Linda D
